tool_args.rationale: The prior submission failed because predict referenced an undefined fit_params variable. This replacement stores numerically fitted parameters in module state and implements the guided barrier-modulated siphon law with fixed tau_scale=3. The existing five rows span broad input and gradient ranges, so no additional probe is needed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The given s_grad values span 0.25–2.25, so the stated narrow-gradient identifiability condition is absent; fitting the guided four-parameter law is preferable to another measurement.
The supplied guidance identifies a static four-parameter transformed siphon law and no long-horizon temporal ambiguity; additional trajectory measurements are not justified.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve a stated parameter ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Tafel exponential and Avrami snapshot models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The authorized shared-subtree guidance specifies co-activation of the barrier-modulated siphon and square-root branch, matching the observed pilot signatures.
